arguments.sql_query:
-- Antimicrobial ATC classes and their concept counts
SELECT 
  c.concept_class_id,
  c.vocabulary_id,
  c.concept_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id) as descendant_count
FROM omop.concept c
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
WHERE c.vocabulary_id = 'ATC'
  AND c.concept_class_id = 'ATC 4th'
  AND c.standard_concept = 'S'
GROUP BY c.concept_class_id, c.vocabulary_id, c.concept_name
ORDER BY descendant_count DESC
LIMIT 30;

content.text: Let me query the clinical data to answer this in steps. First, I'll examine the antimicrobial classes available, then check for resistance signals in the KG (likely via measurement/concept tables), and finally assess prescribing patterns and treatment change frequency.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT TOP 50 c.concept_id, c.concept_name, c.concept_code, c.vocabulary_id, c.domain_id, c.standard_concept 
FROM omop.concept c
WHERE LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%antibiotic%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%beta-lactam%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%aminoglycosid%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%macrolid%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%fluoroquinolone%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%tetracyclin%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%carbapenem%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%glycopeptide%'
   OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%cephalosporin%'
   OR c.concept_class_id = 'Subclass'
ORDER BY c.concept_class_id, c.concept_name
